name: Pickup technical with ZPU 14.5 mm anti-aircraft gun
armament: ZPU-1 or ZPU-2 14.5 mm KPV heavy machine gun mount in the bed
protection: Unarmoured pickup. Game rule treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; gunner seated and exposed. The 14.5 mm gun can penetrate light armour in game.
visual_notes: ZPU-1 single or ZPU-2 twin barrels on a wheeled or pedestal carriage in the bed
Gunner's seat and ring sight; long flash hiders
Hilux or Land Cruiser 79 chassis, often with a cut-down cab
